en-US.name: Taco
en-US.summary: Log food and hear today's calories.
en-US.description: Tell Taco what you ate. Ask how many calories you have had today and what is left.
examplePhrases: Alexa, tell Taco I ate a banana
Alexa, ask Taco how many calories I've had today
Alexa, ask Taco what I have left

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Link the skill with the code shown on the Taco website after signing in with Google.
